facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition, Posts and Electronic Communications approved an annual work plan for 2026 budgeted at 61 billion CFA francs (about 109.4 million dollars); the session date is not given, so the article's publication date is used.
facts.system: Ministry of Digital Transition, Posts and Electronic Communications - 2026 annual work plan

facts.fact: The ministry's 2026 annual work plan budget of 61 billion CFA francs is about double the 2025 envelope of around 30.4 billion CFA francs, per the article (2025 to 2026, a plan budget not a finance-law line).
facts.system: Ministry of Digital Transition, Posts and Electronic Communications - annual work plan 2026 against 2025

note: FASU is named as one channel through which the state co-finances Zero White Zones by 2027, with no law, collection or payment shown, so no acted fact; the work-plan funding sources are not split between state and others.
